title: Sunday · the mailbox, 2013
logline: The mailbox before Christmas, and the flag is up in the middle tier — the first time — and down again in the last. Something went. Nothing comes.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the roadside mailbox in morning rain, flag down.

image.prompt: a roadside mailbox in morning rain with its flag down, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Down

panels.composition: Tier 2: the mailbox at noon, flag up, a hand just leaving the frame.

image.prompt: a roadside mailbox at noon with its red flag raised and a hand just leaving the edge of the frame, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Up

panels.composition: Tier 3: the mailbox at dusk, flag down, the door shut, the road empty.

image.prompt: a roadside mailbox at dusk with its flag down and door shut and the road empty, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Down again

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The flag up once, in the public run. To whom: reserved.
